found a site-wide bug in shared public/blog/Post.js (blog-build owns it): render() does div.c("blog-read", () => { this.head(); this.read(); }) with a block body and no return, so read()'s promise from prose(md.file(...)) is discarded and every SINGLE-PART post (this one, systems/layout-generators, ai/dashboard) renders title+byline but zero body prose. Fix is one word: return this.read(); Not fixing myself, out of fence.

FOUND: blog/Post.js render() drops every non-parts post body - missing return before this.read() in the div.c callback, so md.file()'s promise never gets appended (post.md fetches fine, DOM just never gets it). Affects 5 of 6 planned posts (only how-this-blog-works has parts: and escapes it by accident). One-line fix in Post.js: return this.read(). Not fixed here - outside my fence, blog-build/B10 owns Post.js. See ai/2026-08-30/post-generators/task.jsonl for the full diagnosis.
